Sidebar replaces the current top tab bar.

Live: Dashboard · Signals · Paper Trading
Analysis: Accuracy · Historic · Watchlist · Diagnostics · Settings

Footer carries cycle state and feed health, so it is visible on every screen.
7-day rollover: the Dashboard shows the live window, anything older moves to Historic Data. Same rows, one archive.
BLOCKED: every chart here needs a signal-outcome resolver. Crypto signals are stored as pending and never resolved — only tennis has that job today. Numbers shown are illustrative.

The small-move question you asked about: the histogram buckets every archived signal by target distance, with the 0.118% break-even marked. Red bars are signals that could not have paid for themselves.
